questions.q: The Armed Forces Medical Services invited applications for 120 Short Service Commission Medical Officer posts in November 2026. What is the application window?

questions.subject: Recruitment
questions.q: RRB Isolated Categories recruitment 2026 (CEN 09/2026) offers 191 posts across categories such as Junior Translator and Lab Assistant. What is the last date to apply?

questions.subject: Vacancy alerts
questions.q: After the corrigendum dated 6 November 2026, MPSC Group C vacancies stand at:
questions.e: MPSC Group C Recruitment 2026 was raised from 2,619 to 16,797 posts by a corrigendum dated 6 November 2026. Applications close on 27 November 2026.

questions.subject: Vacancy alerts
questions.q: APPSC's five-category recruitment (Notifications 31/2026 to 36/2026) covers how many posts?
questions.e: APPSC released notifications for five categories: Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector 50, Technical Assistant 36, Royalty Inspector 9, Assistant Chemical Examiner 9, Assistant Director (Mines) 1 and Lab Assistant 1 — 106 posts in all. Online applications run 6-26 November 2026 at psc.ap.gov.in.

questions.subject: Vacancy alerts
questions.q: UPESSC Assistant Teacher (LT Grade) / TGT Recruitment 2026 covers how many posts?

questions.subject: Vacancy alerts
questions.q: KEA SDA/FDA Recruitment 2026 covers how many Group C posts?

questions.subject: Vacancy alerts
questions.q: Indian Maritime University's Mumbai Port Campus invited applications for 20 posts (Faculty, Paramedic, Workshop Instructor, Lab Assistant, Gym Instructor) under Advertisement No. 08/IMU/MPC/Recruit/C/V/2026. What is the last date to send the CV by email?

The 20 posts are on contract and visiting basis: Faculty (Nautical Science) 7, Faculty (Marine Engineering) 5, Paramedic 1, Workshop Instructor (Marine Engineering) 2, Workshop Instructor (Electrical) 2, Lab Assistant (Instructor) 2 and Gym Instructor 1. Selection is by physical interview.

questions.subject: Vacancy alerts
questions.q: The Sports Authority of India will engage 40 Technical Officials for the Softball competition at the Khelo India Youth Games 2026 in Telangana. What is the last date to apply online?
questions.e: Applications for the 40 Technical Officials (Softball) posts, under Notification No. 05/2026/Softball dated 1 November 2026, run from 2 to 12 November 2026 on the SAI jobs portal (sportsauthorityofindia.nic.in/saijobs). Applications by email or post are not accepted, and selection runs on a 100-mark score sheet with no written test.

questions.subject: Vacancy alerts
questions.q: Visakhapatnam Port Authority invited applications for 20 Trade Apprentice placements in its Mechanical and Electrical Engineering Department. Through which portal are applications submitted, and what is the last date?
questions.e: Applications are accepted online only through the National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS) portal, apprenticeshipindia.gov.in, from 4 November to 3 December 2026. The 20 placements cover five ITI trades — Welder, Electrician, Fitter, Motor Mechanic (Motor Vehicle) and Electronics Mechanic, four each — for a one-year apprenticeship. Completion does not guarantee employment with VPA.

questions.subject: Recruitment
questions.q: The National Institute of Hydrology, Roorkee, announced two Junior Research Fellow posts for a project on landslides in Uttarakhand. When is the walk-in interview?
questions.e: The walk-in interview for the two JRF posts (Advt. 65/10/2026-NIH) is on 18 November 2026 at 11:00 AM at NIH, Jalvigyan Bhawan, Roorkee. The project studies hydrological and hydrogeological controls on landslides under climate variability and human interventions in Uttarakhand; the appointment is temporary and co-terminus with the project, paying ₹37,000 per month plus HRA.

questions.subject: Vacancy alerts
questions.q: The Sports Authority of India invited applications for 17 High Performance Coach posts under Advt No. A-12/8/2026-66. What is the last date to apply online?
questions.e: Applications for the 17 High Performance Coach posts are open online from 30 October to 1 December 2026 through the SAI jobs portal. The advertisement is dated 26 October 2026. Separately, SAI's 7 High Performance Director posts close on 17 November 2026 and 11 Deputy Director posts (deputation) close on 20 November 2026.

capsules.body: RRB NTPC Graduate Recruitment 2026 (CEN 06/2026) — 3,548 posts: Chief Commercial-cum-Ticket Supervisor (127), Goods Train Manager (2,750), Junior Accounts Assistant-cum-Typist (300), Senior Clerk-cum-Typist (371). capsules.body: CRPF Sports Quota Recruitment 2026 (Advt R.II-21/2026-Sports) — 521 posts: Head Constable (GD) 182, Constable (GD) 339 across 22 sports disciplines. Age 18–23 (as on 01.08.2026); fee ₹100 (UR/OBC/EWS male), exempt for SC/ST/female/ESM.

capsules.title: Two new Supreme Court recruitments (October 2026)
capsules.body: The Supreme Court of India announced two recruitments in October 2026, both verified on sci.gov.in on 19 October: (1) Junior Court Attendant - 130 tentative posts (Group 'C', Non-Clerical), Advt No. F.3/2026-SC (RC) dated 15 October 2026; Level 3 pay (Rs 21,700-69,100); qualification minimum Class 10 and maximum Class 12; age 18-27 as on 1 October 2026; fee Rs 1,500 (Rs 750 reserved categories); online applications 4-25 November 2026. capsules.body: CGSSB Lecturer 2026: 854 Lecturer (Vyakhyata) posts — E Cadre 424 + T Cadre 430 — in 8 subjects. Advt ESTB-101/207/2025/176; apply 29 Sept–26 Oct 2026 at cgssb.cgstate.gov.in. PG (2nd div) + B.Ed; CG domicile; 21–35 years; Level-09; written exam 29 Nov 2026.

capsules.body: APPSC Group-I Services (166 posts) closes 27 October 2026; Supreme Court Junior Court Assistant (250 posts) closes 28 October 2026; RRB NTPC Graduate (3,548 posts) and UPSSSC Youth Welfare Officer (412 posts) close 6 November 2026; Supreme Court Senior Personal Assistant (65 posts) closes 10 November 2026. capsules.title: BPSC Auditor Mains 2026: 102 posts
capsules.body: The Bihar Public Service Commission invited applications for the Auditor (Bihar Panchayat Audit Service) Main examination, Advertisement No. 09/2026, for 102 posts in the Panchayati Raj Department. capsules.title: RRB NTPC deadlines in November 2026
capsules.body: Two RRB NTPC recruitments close in November 2026: the Graduate drive (CEN 06/2026, 3,548 posts) closes on 6 November, with the fee deadline on 8 November and corrections from 9 to 18 November; the Undergraduate drive (CEN 07/2026, 1,688 posts) closes on 13 November 2026. capsules.body: BPSC TRE 4.0, Advertisement No. 15/2026, covers over 33,320 teacher posts, with fee payment by 2 November 2026 and application submission by 3 November 2026. First-class B.E./B.Tech. or four-year B.Sc. Engineering in the relevant discipline (pass class for SC/ST/PwBD as notified); upper age 25 for General/EWS as of 1 October 2026, with relaxation. Apply 28 October (2 pm) to 18 November 2026 (11:59 pm) at bel-india.in; fee Rs 1,180 for General/OBC (NCL)/EWS; selection by computer-based test (tentatively 22 December 2026) and interview.

capsules.subject: State PSC
capsules.title: UPPSC RO/ARO Examination 2026 — 501 posts, deadline 26 Nov 2026
capsules.body: Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission notified the Samiksha Adhikari / Sahayak Samiksha Adhikari (Review Officer / Assistant Review Officer) Examination 2026, Advt A-4/E-1/2026, for 501 posts (495 general + 6 special recruitment) across state government departments. Bachelor's degree required; age 21-40 years as of 1 July 2026. Exam date to be announced — check only the official website.

capsules.body: Semi-Conductor Laboratory, Mohali (MeitY) — 83 regular posts: Technician 'B' 41, Technical Assistant 30, Junior Personal Assistant 7, Administrative Officer 2, Purchase & Stores Officer 2, Accounts Officer 1. capsules.body: BRIC-Rajiv Gandhi Centre for Biotechnology, Thiruvananthapuram — Technical Officer (2, Level 7), Technical Assistant Group II (3, Level 5), Technical Assistant Group I (3, Level 2). Advertisement of 28 October 2026; apply online by 5 pm on 14 December 2026; maximum age 35 years.

capsules.title: IBPS specialist recruitment: 3 posts, apply by 12 November 2026
capsules.body: The Institute of Banking Personnel Selection issued Advertisement No. IBPS/2026-27/06 dated 29 October 2026 for regular appointments at its Kandivali (East), Mumbai office: Server Administrator (Grade D), Assistant (Grade B) and Programming Assistant (Grade B). The notification did not specify the total number of vacancies; Server Administrator applicants need a B.E./B.Tech in Electronics, Computer Science or Information Technology with three years of Linux server administration and network management experience, and the age limit is 23 to 33 years depending on the post.

capsules.body: Key closing dates in early-to-mid November 2026: RRB NTPC Graduate (CEN 06/2026, 3,548 posts) on 6 November; Delhi University non-teaching posts (126) on 9 November; AAI Southern Region consultants (18 posts) on 10 November (extended date); ESIC professionals (19 posts) on 12 November; RRB NTPC Undergraduate (CEN 07/2026, 1,688 posts) on 13 November; ONGC Industrial Trainees (50 seats) on 15 November; and BEL Probationary Engineers (350 posts) on 18 November 2026. Always verify against the official notification before applying.

capsules.subject: State PSC

capsules.body: 29 October 2026 — The Karnataka Examinations Authority released the SDA/FDA Recruitment 2026 notification covering 5,431 vacancies across Karnataka government departments, boards and corporations, including 2,163 degree-level non-technical posts, 2,070 PUC-level posts, and 563 FDA plus 635 SDA vacancies under the Kalyana Karnataka local cadre. Apply online at cetonline.karnataka.gov.in from 30 October to 25 November 2026.

capsules.subject: University
capsules.title: Delhi University Assistant Recruitment 2026: 215 posts (30 Oct 2026)
capsules.body: 30 October 2026 — The University of Delhi released Advertisement No. R&P/325/2026 for 215 Assistant posts. Apply online at du.ac.in by 19 November 2026 (or within two weeks of publication in Employment News, whichever is later). Check the official notification for eligibility, category-wise vacancies and fee details.

capsules.subject: Railways
capsules.title: Station Master vacancies corrected to 1,265 by 27 October corrigendum
capsules.body: Candidates should note the correction: the Railway Recruitment Boards' corrigendum dated 27 October 2026 revised Station Master vacancies under CEN 08/2026 from 1,215 to 1,265. Some earlier listings and reports show 1,250 posts. The authoritative figure is the corrigendum figure of 1,265 posts, with applications from 27 October to 25 November 2026, Level 6 basic pay of Rs 35,400 per month, and selection through a computer-based test, computer-based aptitude test, document verification and medical examination. Always confirm the figure in the official RRB notification before applying.

capsules.subject: Bihar
capsules.title: BPSC deadline round-up: TRE 4.0 and Auditor Mains (31 October 2026)
capsules.body: Two BPSC deadlines fall in early-to-mid November 2026. TRE 4.0 for 33,320 school teacher posts (Advt. 15/2026): fee by 2 November, online form by 3 November 2026. Auditor Main (Written) Examination for 102 posts (Advt. 09/2026): applications 29 October-16 November 2026, open only to the 1,248 candidates who cleared the 5 July 2026 prelims, with no Main-exam fee. capsules.subject: Vacancy alerts
capsules.title: IBPS three-post recruitment: apply by 12 November 2026 (Advt. IBPS/2026-27/06)
capsules.body: IBPS Advertisement No. IBPS/2026-27/06 invites applications for Server Administrator (Grade D), Assistant (Grade B) and Programming Assistant (Grade B) at IBPS, Kandivali (East), Mumbai. Online registration and fee payment run from 29 October to 12 November 2026; the fee is Rs 250 and the notification does not specify the total vacancies. Selection includes shortlisting, document verification, a 100-question, 100-mark online examination of 90 minutes in English, and an interview. Apply only through the official IBPS website and read the notification PDF before applying.

capsules.subject: Vacancy alerts

capsules.body: Warning: BPSC announced on 30 October 2026 that advertisements 04/2025 to 28/2025 for 1,711 Assistant Professor (speciality) posts in Bihar government medical colleges stand cancelled, because the Health Department withdrew the requisition. capsules.body: UPSSSC notified two Junior Engineer drives on 12 October 2026: 1,156 Mechanical posts (Advt. 24-Exam/2026, apply 3-25 November 2026) and 380 Electrical posts (Advt. 25-Exam/2026, apply 6-27 November 2026). capsules.title: RRB NTPC and Station Master deadlines in November 2026

capsules.body: The Sports Authority of India will engage 40 Technical Officials for the Softball competition at the Khelo India Youth Games 2026 in Telangana, under Notification No. 05/2026/Softball dated 1 November 2026. The application form is available only online on the SAI jobs portal (sportsauthorityofindia.nic.in/saijobs) from 2 to 12 November 2026; applications by email or post are not accepted. capsules.subject: Vacancy alerts
capsules.title: Visakhapatnam Port Authority: 20 Trade Apprentice placements
capsules.body: Visakhapatnam Port Authority has invited applications for 20 Trade Apprentice placements in its Mechanical and Electrical Engineering Department for the apprenticeship year 2025–2026, under Notification No. IM&EE/MOF/E-1/C/2025-26. The placements cover Welder, Electrician, Fitter, Motor Mechanic (Motor Vehicle) and Electronics Mechanic — four in each trade — for a one-year apprenticeship with a monthly stipend. Candidates with an ITI pass in the relevant trade, aged at least 14 years on 3 December 2026, apply online through the NAPS portal (apprenticeshipindia.gov.in) between 4 November and 3 December 2026. Selection is on ITI marks, and completion does not guarantee employment with VPA.
